# How do I access files generated by an application running in the Emulator?

**Symptom**

The sandbox path of the application on the Emulator is different from the actual physical path. As a result, the application files cannot be found.

**Solution**

In the Emulator, there is a mapping between application sandbox paths and physical paths, which is consistent with the real device. For details, see [Mappings Between Application Sandbox Paths and Physical Paths](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/harmonyos-guides/app-sandbox-directory#应用沙箱路径和真实物理路径的对应关系).
